nodes.long_description:
# VR’s Most Popular Multiplayer Physics Sandbox (with Mod Support!)
Let your imagination run wild in our experimental physics playground of 200+ items and endless mod maps, all playable in multiplayer! Best part? It’s FREE!

# 200+ Spawnable Items Pushing the Boundaries of VR
Weapons, Vehicles, Enemies, Props, Blocks, Buildings, Superpowers, and More!

{2604967803196130}

# Mod Support for Unlimited Maps
Create your own maps and modes with no coding skills needed. 50 million mod downloads and counting!

{735571592360704}

# Non-Stop Content Additions
New gadgets, maps, and more keep the surprises coming and fun constantly evolving.

{1478480356572702}

# Join Our Discord for updates, betas, and giveaways!
https://dsc.gg/downshot

nodes.long_description: Still in development. The world around you has advanced physics, even your foes. Use guns, blades, and whatever else you can find to stay alive. Explore breath-taking levels. All for free. Story coming soon!

Wheeled vehicles improvements:

Visuals:
- Dynamic item volumetric lighting support
- DOWNSHOT volumetric lighting (see more below)
- Reflection capture support now togglable per map
- Baked sun/sky visibility probes
- Volumetric lighting scalars
- Dynamic offset oblivious reflections moved to level settings
- Sun occlusion actor setting
- Ambient occlusion override actor setting
- Both engine volumetric lighting and downshot volumetric lighting fully compatible with mobile auto instancing

DOWNSHOT Volumetric Lighting
- High performance per vertex point lights for movable meshes
- Baked volumetric point light shadowing for movable meshes
- Compatible with engine sun/sky probes
- Supports custom sky occlusion logic per level
- Smooth engine spherical harmonic fallback with overlapping lights
- Near constant gpu cost regardless of point light count

(Both volumetric lighting variants are not compatible with mod shaders at this time, because it requires edits to engine shaders. Opt in support is under development)

SDK 1.15:
- Custom mod menu support, mod devs can create widgets that the game allows users to open from the downshot ui. (Place user widget derived blueprints in the UserWidgets mod folder subfolder)
- Level settings window linked to each level object. This replaced the old ApplyLevelSettings() node and other calls 
- Additional graphics settings like reflections and lighting settings
- Multithreading support and node
- Unrestricted for loop (can be paired with multithreading if you have for loops that exceed the blueprint loop limit)
- Some outdated info removed
- Additions and tweaks to template map
- Reliable string server rpc
- Tooltip tweaks
- GetActorNetStatus() (new upgraded version of GetActorNetOwnership())
- GetLocalTeller()
